items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer references 'Chilton's book' and 'Chilton' to correct or provide facts about the interviewee's life (e.g., family moving to NY, playing with Wilbur Sweetman). The interviewee responds to these facts but does not mention any personal interaction with John Chilton.

ctx.x: So far, John Chilton is right.
